name: Google Public DNS (DNS-over-HTTPS JSON API)
tier_rationale: Established company with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 BR2); default resolver by council decision (P029 cond 6).

reliability.justification: Validating public resolver returning authoritative answers; every query carries edns_client_subnet=0.0.0.0/0 so the egress subnet never reaches the target's nameservers (P029 cond 2).

doh.title: DNS-over-HTTPS JSON answers (dns.google/resolve)

terms.quote: Default resolvers are limited to providers whose terms allow business use, recorded with evidence in the provider registry (Google Public DNS, Cloudflare 1.1.1.1, Quad9; tier trusted).

doh.notes: Quote: binding council text (P029 cond 6); research record C0003 'Free public resolvers (Google/Cloudflare terms)'. Re-check the terms page with doctor --licences --refresh.

notes: Owned by core (WP02); provider_id of the 'google' resolver of core/dns.py.
